title: feat(content): harness entry ships standalone skills (F17)

req_statements.R1: WHEN the `harness-standard` project entry renders its `highlights` in any of the three languages, the system SHALL include a highlight stating that the harness process ships as standalone skills installable with `npx skills add jordimarsal/harness`.  Verification: content spec asserts that for slug `harness-standard`, `highlights.en`, `highlights.es` and `highlights.ca` each contain a line matching `/npx skills add jordimarsal\/harness/`.
req_statements.R2: The `harness-standard` entry SHALL include a metric with value `6` and label `skills` (same word in en, es and ca).  Verification: content spec asserts `metrics` of `harness-standard` contains `{ value: '6', label: { en: 'skills', es: 'skills', ca: 'skills' } }`.
req_statements.R3: The system shall not modify the `harness-standard` slug, `name`, `github` URL, `dept`, `tier`, or any field of any other project entry.  Verification: existing content-spec assertions (department project lists, positive tooling list, thesis-tier list) stay green without modification; the feature diff touches only `highlights` and `metrics` of the `harness-standard` entry.
req_statements.R4: The added copy SHALL claim skills installability only; it shall not state or imply publication on the Anthropic skills registry.  Verification: content spec asserts the added highlight lines contain neither `Anthropic` nor `registry`; reviewer confirms wording by inspection.
